summary:
GREEN agent 3 (the client half of U8) finished in about 27 minutes (22:49 to 23:16 AST). Before editing I re-hashed the 24 files named in the two GREEN reports; all matched. I checked the toolchain by path: @babel/core and .bin/jest exist, tsc is 5.9.3, jest 29.7.0, eslint v9.39.4.

What I wrote:
(a) src/services/api.ts: `export const LANDING_BASE_URL = 'https://qaren-landing-production.up.railway.app';` on line 24, four lines below API_BASE_URL (line 20), with no trailing slash.
(b) src/screens/LegalScreen.tsx:
- `lang` comes from `useTranslation().i18n?.language` through a local `legalLang()` that returns 'ar' when the value is a string starting with 'ar', else 'en'. An undefined language gives 'en'.
- The request is `api.get(endpoint, { params: { lang } })`.
- The cache key is `legal_cache_{doc}_{lang}`. The pre-U8 key is never read and is not removed (UG19 allowed removal; I left it out).
- The error state has exactly one TouchableOpacity with `accessibilityRole="link"`, labelled `t('legal.error.openWeb')`. It calls `Linking.openURL(`${LANDING_BASE_URL}/${lang === 'ar' ? 'ar/' : ''}${privacy.html|terms.html}`)` and swallows a rejection.
- The screen has no URL literal. The new link style is centred with no physical left/right, so the layout is RTL-safe. The DirectionalIcon site count is unchanged.
(c) One catalog key, `legal.error.openWeb`, in en.json ("Open the web version") and ar.json.
(d) ADDRESS_COUNTS in landing.brand.s69.test.ts (UG20): privacy.html, terms.html, ar/privacy.html and ar/terms.html go from 7 to 5 each. Each page keeps its 4 head links and its footer support@ mailto. The hand-written body contact line (2 per page: mailto href plus text; privacy@ on privacy pages, legal@ on terms pages) is now rendered from the markdown, where the address is a PRIVACY_EMAIL or SUPPORT_EMAIL placeholder (legal@ dropped per C29). support.html and ar/support.html stay at 9: the new legal region was added and no address was removed.

stated_limits: The pre-U8 cache key legal_cache_{doc} is never read, but it is NOT removed from device storage. UG19 made removal optional; I left it out so the screen has no untested branch. The old DRAFT copy stays in AsyncStorage on phones that cached it, unread.

lang is computed on every render. A UI-language change while LegalScreen is mounted changes the endpoint/cache-key dependencies and re-fetches in the new language. This is intended, but no test pins it.
The language rule is the binding one: startsWith('ar') on the raw i18next value, with no lower-casing. 'AR' gives 'en'. The clients only use 'ar'/'en', so this is unreachable (UG18).
landing.brand.s69.test.ts lines 25-26 (docstring) still say 'ADDRESS_COUNTS are unchanged'. That is now stale, but rule (3) limits my edit to ADDRESS_COUNTS, so I did not touch it.

With LegalScreen.test.tsx's api mock (default only, no LANDING_BASE_URL) the link URL would be 'undefined/privacy.html'. No node in that file presses the link, so this matters only if a future test does.
